message.content: This vertical editorial illustration features two caricatured men and an oil lamp against a textured purple background. At the lower left, a man with a large forehead, closed eyes, and a small chin wears a white collared shirt. He holds a brass-colored oil lamp with both hands; a thin trail of smoke rises from its spout. Emerging from a thick cloud of white smoke that fills the center and upper right of the frame is the upper torso of a second, larger man. This figure has white hair and a beard, wears wire-rimmed glasses and a white skullcap, and is dressed in a white tunic. His arms are crossed, and he gazes downward toward the smaller man. Large red letters spelling "TEMPO" are partially obscured behind the larger figure's head. Black text in the center reads "SIMSALABIM USTAD ABU". Further white text below discusses "ABU BAKAR BA'ASYIR" and "JOKOWI". Additional headlines appear at the top, and a barcode and date "28 JANUARI-3 FEBRUARI 2019" are in the bottom right corner.
